key: ANNA: You're back.
en: ANNA: You're back.
ja: アンナ: 戻ってきたね。

key: It's okay.
en: It's okay.
ja: 大丈夫だよ。

key: Haven't you noticed the continuity gets a little confusing whenever you lose?
en: Haven't you noticed the continuity gets a little confusing whenever you lose?
ja: 負けるたびに、流れがちょっとおかしくなるの、気づいてなかった?

key: Nostra and I are trying to brush over any hiccoughs as much as possible, but we can't do it perfectly.
en: Nostra and I are trying to brush over any hiccoughs as much as possible, but we can't do it perfectly.
ja: ノストラとあたしで、できるだけつじつまを合わせようとしてるんだけど、完璧にはできなくて。

key: Let's give it one more shot, okay?
en: Let's give it one more shot, okay?
ja: もう一回やってみよう、いい?

key: Nostra, we're going again!
en: Nostra, we're going again!
ja: ノストラ、もう一度お願い!

key: ANNA: \PN! You made it!
en: ANNA: \PN! You made it!
ja: アンナ: \PN! やっと来たね!

key: Sorry for disappearing just before everything went crazy, but I had a lot of things I needed to do...
en: Sorry for disappearing just before everything went crazy, but I had a lot of things I needed to do...
ja: 全部おかしくなる直前にいなくなっちゃってごめんね、やらなきゃいけないことがたくさんあって……

key: Still, you got through everything and made it here!
en: Still, you got through everything and made it here!
ja: それでも、全部乗り越えてここまで来てくれたんだね!

key: That's exactly what I'd expect from the one Nostra chose!
en: That's exactly what I'd expect from the one Nostra chose!
ja: さすがノストラが選んだ人だよ!

key: Anyway, there's a LOT that I have to explain now.
en: Anyway, there's a LOT that I have to explain now.
ja: とにかく、今、説明しなきゃいけないことがたくさんあるの。

key: I'm sorry for not telling you these things sooner, but I get so caught up in trying to make everything work that I just forget to explain it right.
en: I'm sorry for not telling you these things sooner, but I get so caught up in trying to make everything work that I just forget to explain it right.
ja: もっと早く伝えなかったのはごめんね、でも全部うまくいかせようとしてると、説明するのを忘れちゃうんだよね。

key: Basically...
en: Basically...
ja: つまり……

key: This isn't the first time this has happened.
en: This isn't the first time this has happened.
ja: これが起こったのは、今回が初めてじゃないんだ。

key: This conflict with Team Meteor suddenly escalating to this point...
en: This conflict with Team Meteor suddenly escalating to this point...
ja: チームメテオとの対立がここまで急激に膨れ上がったこと……

key: Even everything that happened with Heather's dad, and those sorority girls, and the teacher at Apophyll...
en: Even everything that happened with Heather's dad, and those sorority girls, and the teacher at Apophyll...
ja: ヘザーのお父さんのことも、あのソロリティの子たちも、アポフィルの先生のことも……

key: So much of this happened before.
en: So much of this happened before.
ja: そのほとんどが、以前にも起こってたの。

key: But back then, it was different-- and faster.
en: But back then, it was different-- and faster.
ja: でもあの時は、違ったんだ――もっと速かった。

key: The old champion died alongside you, when you would have first come to the region.
en: The old champion died alongside you, when you would have first come to the region.
ja: 昔のチャンピオンは、あなたが最初にこの地方に来たとき、あなたと一緒に亡くなったの。

key: Truthfully I don't even remember it myself; I just know what Nostra told me.
en: Truthfully I don't even remember it myself; I just know what Nostra told me.
ja: 正直、あたし自身も覚えてないんだけど、ノストラから聞いた話だから。

key: Back then, I made a wish to try and save the world.
en: Back then, I made a wish to try and save the world.
ja: あの時、あたしは世界を救おうと願い事をしたの。

key: It was such an earth-shattering, reality-bending wish that Nostra could hardly maintain her presence in the world she rewound.
en: It was such an earth-shattering, reality-bending wish that Nostra could hardly maintain her presence in the world she rewound.
ja: それはあまりにも世界を揺るがす、現実をゆがめるような願いで、ノストラは巻き戻した世界の中に存在をほとんど保てなかったの。

key: That's why she's like this, you know?
en: That's why she's like this, you know?
ja: だからノストラはあんな姿になっちゃったんだよ、わかる?

key: And it's not just her-- that boy, too.
en: And it's not just her-- that boy, too.
ja: それに、あの姿になったのはノストラだけじゃなくて――あの男の子も。

key: His body was the sacrifice necessary to rewind the world so dramatically.
en: His body was the sacrifice necessary to rewind the world so dramatically.
ja: あそこまで劇的に世界を巻き戻すために、彼の体が必要な犠牲になったんだ。

key: But that wish...
en: But that wish...
ja: でもあの願いは……

key: It brought me you, \PN.
en: It brought me you, \PN.
ja: それが\PNをあたしのところに連れてきてくれたんだよ。

key: Trying to control an entire timeline just on Nostra's guidance alone has been tough...
en: Trying to control an entire timeline just on Nostra's guidance alone has been tough...
ja: ノストラの案内だけを頼りに、時間軸全体をコントロールしようとするのは大変だった……

key: Unexpected things kept happening, but we've tried to correct it as much as possible.
en: Unexpected things kept happening, but we've tried to correct it as much as possible.
ja: 予想外のことがずっと起こってて、それでもできる限り正そうとしてきたの。

key: After all, if things became too different, Nostra wouldn't know how to help.
en: After all, if things became too different, Nostra wouldn't know how to help.
ja: だって、変化が大きすぎたら、ノストラも何を助ければいいかわからなくなっちゃうから。

key: I'm sure I've caused you a lot of inconveniences that way, even if you didn't know it.
en: I'm sure I've caused you a lot of inconveniences that way, even if you didn't know it.
ja: そのせいで、気づいてなくても、色々迷惑かけてきたと思うよ。

key: For instance, even though Ame was still alive, I asked her to stay out of things long enough so that you would gain enough experience to persevere.
en: For instance, even though Ame was still alive, I asked her to stay out of things long enough so that you would gain enough experience to persevere.
ja: 例えば、アメがまだ生きてたときも、あなたが十分な経験を積んで乗り越えられるようになるまで、しばらく関わらないでいてってお願いしたの。

key: You have to believe me when I say that everything I've done was just to build you up strong enough so that you could eventually defeat Lin!
en: You have to believe me when I say that everything I've done was just to build you up strong enough so that you could eventually defeat Lin!
ja: 信じてほしいんだけど、あたしがやってきたことは全部、あなたがいつかリンを倒せるくらい強くなれるようにするためだったんだよ!

key: Before, she was too powerful for anyone to take on.
en: Before, she was too powerful for anyone to take on.
ja: 以前は、誰も彼女に太刀打ちできないくらい強すぎたの。

key: You being here and opposing them has slowed them down so much!
en: You being here and opposing them has slowed them down so much!
ja: あなたがここにいて彼らに立ち向かってくれたおかげで、すごく足止めできたんだ!

key: And soon, you should be able to beat her!
en: And soon, you should be able to beat her!
ja: もうすぐ、彼女を倒せるはずだよ!

key: I'll try and make it short though.
en: I'll try and make it short though.
ja: なるべく手短に説明するね。

key: You may not believe me, and that's okay.
en: You may not believe me, and that's okay.
ja: 信じてもらえないかもしれないけど、それでもいいの。

key: Things haven't gone exactly as planned...
en: Things haven't gone exactly as planned...
ja: 物事は計画通りには進んでこなかった……

key: But you should be able to beat her!
en: But you should be able to beat her!
ja: でも、あなたなら彼女を倒せるはずだよ!

key: You're like a pawn that reached the end of the board.
en: You're like a pawn that reached the end of the board.
ja: あなたは、盤の端まで到達した駒みたいなものなの。

key: And this is the final stage of my wish!
en: And this is the final stage of my wish!
ja: そして、これがあたしの願いの最終段階なんだよ!

key: Nostra!
en: Nostra!
ja: ノストラ!

key: Please finish the job!
en: Please finish the job!
ja: 仕上げをお願い!

key: With this battle, you'll have the strength you need to finally face Lin!
en: With this battle, you'll have the strength you need to finally face Lin!
ja: このバトルで、あなたはついにリンと向き合うための力を手にするはずだよ!

key: This is your promotion!
en: This is your promotion!
ja: これがあなたの昇進なんだよ!

key: If stars never fell, how would anyone make their wishes?
en: If stars never fell, how would anyone make their wishes?
ja: 星が　落ちてこなかったら　みんな　なにに　お願いするの?

key: ANNA: There you go.
en: ANNA: There you go.
ja: アンナ: よし、これでいいよ。

key: No need to worry.
en: No need to worry.
ja: 心配いらないから。

key: We've rewound her part of time again for you.
en: We've rewound her part of time again for you.
ja: 彼女の時間の部分は、またあなたのために巻き戻したよ。

key: We'll do it as much as it takes until you win.
en: We'll do it as much as it takes until you win.
ja: あなたが勝つまで、何度でもやるからね。

key: After all, I said we'd be right there with you, right?
en: After all, I said we'd be right there with you, right?
ja: だって、ずっとそばにいるって言ったでしょ?

key: This victory belongs to you.
en: This victory belongs to you.
ja: この勝利は、あなたのものだよ。

key: Now go for it!
en: Now go for it!
ja: さあ、行って!

key: ANNA: That's it, then...
en: ANNA: That's it, then...
ja: アンナ: これで終わり……

key: Take a rest, Nostra.
en: Take a rest, Nostra.
ja: 休んでね、ノストラ。

key: After everything and so long, you've beyond earned it.
en: After everything and so long, you've beyond earned it.
ja: 今までずっと、それだけの働きをしてくれたよ。

key: And, \PN?
en: And, \PN?
ja: それから、\PN?

key: Thank you for playing this game with me.
en: Thank you for playing this game with me.
ja: あたしとこのゲームに付き合ってくれてありがとう。

key: I've been... really, horribly selfish.
en: I've been... really, horribly selfish.
ja: あたし……本当にひどく、身勝手だったの。

key: Not only didn't I tell anyone what was going on, but I--
en: Not only didn't I tell anyone what was going on, but I--
ja: 何が起きてるか誰にも言わなかっただけじゃなくて、あたし――

key: I guess I've been running from the fact that this was all my fault to begin with.
en: I guess I've been running from the fact that this was all my fault to begin with.
ja: これが全部あたしのせいだったっていう事実から、ずっと逃げてたんだと思う。

key: You see, Lin--
en: You see, Lin--
ja: あのね、リンは――

key: Isn't what she seems.
en: Isn't what she seems.
ja: 見た目通りの子じゃないの。

key: When I was still at the orphanage, we all used to play games as much as we could together.
en: When I was still at the orphanage, we all used to play games as much as we could together.
ja: あたしがまだ孤児院にいた頃、みんなでよく一緒にゲームをして遊んでたの。

key: And there was one game that I was always the best at.
en: And there was one game that I was always the best at.
ja: その中に、あたしがいつも一番得意だったゲームがあって。

key: Chess, of course!
en: Chess, of course!
ja: もちろん、チェスだよ!

key: No one could even stand a chance against me... except for one other girl.
en: No one could even stand a chance against me...  except for one other girl.
ja: 誰もあたしに敵わなかった……たった一人の女の子を除いては。

key: Her name was Lin.
en: Her name was Lin.
ja: その子の名前はリンって言ったの。

key: In the end, we developed kind of a rivalry.
en: In the end, we developed kind of a rivalry.
ja: 結局、あたしたちの間には一種のライバル関係が生まれたんだ。

key: I thought it was all in good spirits fun until one day, I suddenly reversed a losing game on her and won.
en: I thought it was all in good spirits fun until one day, I suddenly reversed a losing game on her and won.
ja: ある日、負けそうなゲームを急にひっくり返して勝つまでは、それも全部いい雰囲気の楽しいものだと思ってたの。

key: She snapped at me, and the Doctor got angry, and both of them started yelling and...
en: She snapped at me, and the Doctor got angry, and both of them started yelling and...
ja: 彼女はあたしにキレて、ドクターも怒って、二人とも怒鳴り始めて……

key: Well, I never saw her again after she was put into the Circuit.
en: Well, I never saw her again after she was put into the Circuit.
ja: 結局、彼女がサーキットに入れられてから、二度と会うことはなかったの。

key: I heard she escaped that night, but the Doctor refused to ever talk about it.
en: I heard she escaped that night, but the Doctor refused to ever talk about it.
ja: その夜逃げ出したって聞いたけど、ドクターはそのことについて話すのを絶対に拒んだ。

key: Then, before long, the Lin we know now appeared and started pulling strings elsewhere.
en: Then, before long, the Lin we know now appeared and started pulling strings elsewhere.
ja: それから間もなく、今あたしたちが知ってるリンが現れて、他のところで糸を引き始めた。

key: There's no doubt in my mind that it's the same Lin.
en: There's no doubt in my mind that it's the same Lin.
ja: あたしの中では、それが同一人物のリンだって疑いはないの。

key: And I think...
en: And I think...
ja: それに、あたし思うんだけど……

key: All of this has still been some kind of game to her.
en: All of this has still been some kind of game to her.
ja: これ全部、今でも彼女にとっては一種のゲームなんだと思う。

key: She hasn't come after me in specific...
en: She hasn't come after me in specific...
ja: 彼女はあたしを特別に狙ってきたわけじゃない……

key: But if I were her opponent, would she?
en: But if I were her opponent, would she?
ja: でも、もしあたしが彼女の対戦相手だったら、狙ってきたと思う?

key: I know I'm such a child to have let a stupid rivalry come this far.
en: I know I'm such a child to have let a stupid rivalry come this far.
ja: くだらないライバル関係をここまで引きずらせるなんて、あたしって本当に子供だなって思う。

key: But that's all the more reason why we have to end it now!
en: But that's all the more reason why we have to end it now!
ja: でもだからこそ、今、これを終わらせなきゃいけないの!

key: I couldn't do it myself before.
en: I couldn't do it myself before.
ja: あたし一人じゃ、前はできなかった。

key: That's why I'm counting on you.
en: That's why I'm counting on you.
ja: だから、あなたを頼りにしてるの。

key: Thank you for everything.
en: Thank you for everything.
ja: 全部ありがとう。

key: Please...
en: Please...
ja: お願い……

key: ANNA: Take this.
en: ANNA: Take this.
ja: アンナ: これを受け取って。

key: ANNA: It may seem like a bad thing at first, but trust me.
en: ANNA: It may seem like a bad thing at first, but trust me.
ja: アンナ: 最初は悪いことのように思えるかもしれないけど、信じて。

key: This is for the best.
en: This is for the best.
ja: これが一番いいことなの。

key: We'll be right there with you too, okay?
en: We'll be right there with you too, okay?
ja: あたしたちも、あなたのそばにいるからね?

key: You can do it.
en: You can do it.
ja: あなたならできる。

key: Because you're the one Nostra chose.
en: Because you're the one Nostra chose.
ja: だって、あなたはノストラが選んだ人だから。

key: Because you've already come this far.
en: Because you've already come this far.
ja: だって、あなたはもうここまで来たから。

key: And because...
en: And because...
ja: それに……

key: For everyone's sake, we have to win.
en: For everyone's sake, we have to win.
ja: みんなのために、勝たなきゃいけないから。

key: Good luck out there.
en: Good luck out there.
ja: 外じゃ　気をつけな

key: ANNA: Go ahead.
en: ANNA: Go ahead.
ja: アンナ: さあ、行って。

key: You aren't fighting this battle alone.
en: You aren't fighting this battle alone.
ja: この戦いは、あなた一人だけのものじゃないよ。

key: Me, Nostra, your Pokémon...
en: Me, Nostra, your Pokémon...
ja: あたし、ノストラ、あなたのポケモンたち……

key: We're all with you to the very end.
en: We're all with you to the very end.
ja: みんな最後まであなたと一緒だよ。

key: AME: Anna's a great kid, but somebody needs to tell her to treat her toys better...
en: AME: Anna's a great kid, but somebody needs to tell her to treat her toys better...
ja: アメ: アンナはいい子だけど、誰か、おもちゃはもっと大事に扱うもんだって教えてあげないとね……

key: I can't believe she requested this set-up...
en: I can't believe she requested this set-up...
ja: こんな仕掛け頼んだなんて信じられないよ……

key: She said something about it being because she feels guilty, but I don't... get it.
en: She said something about it being because she feels guilty, but I don't... get it.
ja: 罪悪感があるからとか言ってたけど、あたしにはよく……わかんないな。

key: I should never have approved this, I should never have approved this~...
en: I should never have approved this, I should never have approved this~...
ja: こんなの承認するんじゃなかった、こんなの承認するんじゃなかった……

key: Celebi seems curious about who that voice belonged to.
en: Celebi seems curious about who that voice belonged to.
ja: セレビィは、その声が誰のものか気になっているようだ。

key: Celebi seems pretty tired out after all the time travel.
en: Celebi seems pretty tired out after all the time travel.
ja: セレビィは、時間旅行を続けてすっかり疲れているようだ。

key: Celebi seems full of energy and ready to go!
en: Celebi seems full of energy and ready to go!
ja: セレビィは元気いっぱいで、準備万端のようだ!

key: Do you want to travel through time again?
en: Do you want to travel through time again?
ja: もう一度時間を旅したいですか?

key: You once again feel your surroundings fade away around you as Celebi brings you forward through time!
en: You once again feel your surroundings fade away around you as Celebi brings you forward through time!
ja: セレビィがあなたを時間の中へ連れて行くと、再び周囲が消えていくのを感じる!

key: Celebi looks a little impatient, but will wait for you.
en: Celebi looks a little impatient, but will wait for you.
ja: セレビィは少し焦れったそうにしているが、あなたを待ってくれる。

key: TAKA: But why would she be in here, she's not Elite Four...
en: TAKA: But why would she be in here, she's not Elite Four...
ja: タカ: でも、なんで彼女がここにいるんだろう、四天王じゃないのに……

key: TAKA: ...I don't really like this room.
en: TAKA: ...I don't really like this room.
ja: タカ: …この部屋、あんまり好きじゃないな。

key: I didn't have proper toys growing up--
en: I didn't have proper toys growing up--
ja: 俺、ちゃんとしたおもちゃなんて持って育たなかったから――

key: So, seeing all of this is kind of...
en: So, seeing all of this is kind of...
ja: だから、こういうの見ると、ちょっと……

key: ELIAS: Of course it's her.
en: ELIAS: Of course it's her.
ja: イライアス: もちろん彼女です。

key: Another person whose death I am responsible for.
en: Another person whose death I am responsible for.
ja: また一人、私が死に責任のある者が。

key: ELIAS: As eerie I find this room, she at least made the right choice going for stairs.
en: ELIAS: As eerie I find this room, she at least made the right choice going for stairs.
ja: イライアス: この部屋は不気味に感じますが、彼女は少なくとも階段を選んだのは正解でしたね。

key: My floating platforms constantly break.
en: My floating platforms constantly break.
ja: 私の浮遊プラットフォームはしょっちゅう壊れますから。

key: TAKA: We're so close to our time, the next jump will have to get us back, right?
en: TAKA: We're so close to our time, the next jump will have to get us back, right?
ja: タカ: 俺たちの時代にすごく近いよな、次のジャンプで戻れるはずだよな?

key: ELIAS: We should be going back to the present now.
en: ELIAS: We should be going back to the present now.
ja: イライアス: そろそろ現在に戻るべきでしょう。

key: These meetings have all been...
en: These meetings have all been...
ja: これらの再会は、すべて……

key: I'm glad I got to see them all again.
en: I'm glad I got to see them all again.
ja: もう一度みんなに会えて、良かったです。

key: AME: Shimmer, give me a boost.
en: AME: Shimmer, give me a boost.
ja: アメ: シマー、ちょっと持ち上げて。

key: I can almost reach them...
en: I can almost reach them...
ja: もう少しで届きそうなんだけど……

key: AME: Gah!
en: AME: Gah!
ja: アメ: ガッ!

key: Officer, I swear, I didn't sneak into Anna's room while she was away with the sole purpose of rescuing all these toys!
en: Officer, I swear, I didn't sneak into Anna's room while she was away with the sole purpose of rescuing all these toys!
ja: おまわりさん、誓って言うけど、アンナが留守の間に、おもちゃを全部救出する目的だけでこっそり部屋に入ったなんてことはないから!

key: That's a preposterous accusation which I can't believe you'd make!
en: That's a preposterous accusation which I can't believe you'd make!
ja: そんなの、あんたが言い出すなんて信じられないくらいとんでもない言いがかりだよ!

key: I'm hurt!
en: I'm hurt!
ja: 傷ついた!

key: Wounded!
en: Wounded!
ja: 心が痛い!

key: My heart weeps at the mere insinuation!
en: My heart weeps at the mere insinuation!
ja: そのほのめかしだけで心が泣いてるよ!

key: AME: And even if it were true...
en: AME: And even if it were true...
ja: アメ: それに、たとえそれが本当だったとしても……

key: I shan't be pressured and shamed by some thuggish officer of the state for trying to do the right thing!
en: I shan't be pressured and shamed by some thuggish officer of the state for trying to do the right thing!
ja: 正しいことをしようとしただけなのに、国家の乱暴な役人に圧力かけられて恥をかかされるなんてごめんだからね!

key: I will give each of these toys a safe home, and nobody is going to stop me!
en: I will give each of these toys a safe home, and nobody is going to stop me!
ja: このおもちゃたち全部に、安全な家を与えてあげるんだから、誰にも止めさせないよ!

key: ...This doesn't mean you're Champion now, right?
en: ...This doesn't mean you're Champion now, right?
ja: Amethyst	…これって、あなたが今チャンピオンになったってことじゃないよね?

key: AME: Whoa, what kind of officer are you that you can beat me so easily!?
en: AME: Whoa, what kind of officer are you that you can beat me so easily!?
ja: アメ: うわ、こんなに簡単にあたしを倒せるなんて、一体どんなおまわりさんなの!?

key: TAKA: Uh, hi. We're nothing to do with the police...
en: TAKA: Uh, hi. We're nothing to do with the police...
ja: タカ: あ、どうも。俺たち警察とは何の関係もなくて……

key: TAKA: I'm Taka. And you just battled \PN.
en: TAKA: I'm Taka. And you just battled \PN.
ja: タカ: 俺はタカ。それで、あなたはさっき\PNと戦ったんですよね。

key: We're kind of from the future.
en: We're kind of from the future.
ja: 俺たち、未来から来たっていうか。

key: AME: Oh! And over there must be that time traveling lettuce Pokémon I saw in one of the books in Elias' room?
en: AME: Oh! And over there must be that time traveling lettuce Pokémon I saw in one of the books in Elias' room?
ja: アメ: あ! それじゃあそこにいるのは、イライアスの部屋の本の中で見たあの、時間旅行するレタスポケモン?

key: TAKA: ...Do you make a habit of going into the Elite Four's rooms when they aren't here?
en: TAKA: ...Do you make a habit of going into the Elite Four's rooms when they aren't here?
ja: タカ: …あなたって、四天王がいないときに部屋に入るのが習慣なんですか?

key: AME: Do you make a habit of impersonating police?
en: AME: Do you make a habit of impersonating police?
ja: アメ: あんたは警察のふりをするのが習慣なの?

key: That sounds like a crime.
en: That sounds like a crime.
ja: それって犯罪っぽく聞こえるけど。

key: TAKA: We didn't... Nevermind.
en: TAKA: We didn't... Nevermind.
ja: タカ: 俺たちはしてな……いや、なんでもないです。

key: Celebi just needs to rest before time traveling-- so we've been making small jumps to get back home.
en: Celebi just needs to rest before time traveling-- so we've been making small jumps to get back home.
ja: セレビィは時間旅行の前に休む必要があるだけなので――だから、家に帰るために少しずつジャンプを重ねてるんです。

key: It seems like we're pretty close to our time period though, so we can get out of your hair and leave you to...
en: It seems like we're pretty close to our time period though, so we can get out of your hair and leave you to...
ja: 俺たちの時代にかなり近いみたいなので、もうお邪魔せずに、あなたを……

key: Doing nothing criminal whatsoever, I guess.
en: Doing nothing criminal whatsoever, I guess.
ja: 何も犯罪的でないことに専念させてあげられそうです。

key: AME: Hey, hold up a minute...
en: AME: Hey, hold up a minute...
ja: アメ: ちょっと、待ちなよ……

key: \PN, right? You're a very talented trainer.
en: \PN, right? You're a very talented trainer.
ja: \PNだよね? すごい才能のあるトレーナーだね。

key: Have you challenged the League in your time?
en: Have you challenged the League in your time?
ja: 自分の時代でリーグに挑戦したことある?

key: If not, you should-- you might have what it takes to go all the way!
en: If not, you should-- you might have what it takes to go all the way!
ja: まだなら、挑戦するべきだよ――一番上まで行ける素質があるかもしれないよ!

key: TAKA: About that...
en: TAKA: About that...
ja: タカ: それなんですけど……

key: \PN is your successor as Champion.
en: \PN is your successor as Champion.
ja: \PNはあなたの後継者で、今のチャンピオンなんです。

key: AME: Wait, so you've beaten me twice now?
en: AME: Wait, so you've beaten me twice now?
ja: アメ: え、じゃああたし、もう二回もあんたに負けたってこと?

key: That's incredible!
en: That's incredible!
ja: すごいじゃん!

key: My dream was to build up this League to attract the best trainers from all around the world...
en: My dream was to build up this League to attract the best trainers from all around the world...
ja: あたしの夢は、このリーグを世界中から最高のトレーナーを引きつけられるものにすることだったの……

key: And clearly it worked! I couldn't be happier!
en: And clearly it worked! I couldn't be happier!
ja: そして、明らかにうまくいったってわけね! こんなにうれしいことないよ!

key: To think my League attracted such an incredible trainer...
en: To think my League attracted such an incredible trainer...
ja: あたしのリーグがこんなすごいトレーナーを引きつけたなんてね……

key: Well, don't let me keep you!
en: Well, don't let me keep you!
ja: さあ、あたしのことは気にしないで!

key: You should get back to your time-- say "Hi" to me when you get back!
en: You should get back to your time-- say "Hi" to me when you get back!
ja: 自分の時代に戻ったほうがいいよ――戻ったら、あたしによろしくって言っといて!

key: I will give each of these toys a safe home, and nobody is going stop me!
en: I will give each of these toys a safe home, and nobody is going stop me!
ja: このおもちゃたち全部に、安全な家を与えてあげるんだから、誰にも止めさせないよ!

key: AME: Whoa, what kind of officer are you that you can beat me so--
en: AME: Whoa, what kind of officer are you that you can beat me so--
ja: アメ: うわ、こんなに簡単にあたしを倒せるなんて、一体どんなおまわりさんな――

key: Wait, Elias!? Is this trainer with you?
en: Wait, Elias!? Is this trainer with you?
ja: 待って、イライアス!? このトレーナー、あんたの知り合い?

key: Did you sneak in here to rescue all of Anna's toys?
en: Did you sneak in here to rescue all of Anna's toys?
ja: アンナのおもちゃを全部救出するために、こっそり忍び込んだの?

key: Bringing a friend was a good call; I'm struggling to reach.
en: Bringing a friend was a good call; I'm struggling to reach.
ja: 友達連れてきたのは正解だったね、届かなくて困ってたから。

key: ELIAS: Amethyst.
en: ELIAS: Amethyst.
ja: イライアス: アメジスト。

key: That's very much your hobby, not mine.
en: That's very much your hobby, not mine.
ja: それはあくまであなたの趣味であって、私の趣味ではありません。

key: AME: I have no idea what you're talking about.
en: AME: I have no idea what you're talking about.
ja: アメ: 何のことだか、さっぱりわかんないな。

key: I have never done anything of questionable legality in my life.
en: I have never done anything of questionable legality in my life.
ja: あたし、人生でグレーな行為なんて一度もしたことないもん。

key: Shimmer appears to be doing a dance to try to distract you while Ame hides a definitely-stolen Cleffa doll.
en: Shimmer appears to be doing a dance to try to distract you while Ame hides a definitely-stolen Cleffa doll.
ja: シマーは、あなたの気を逸らそうとダンスをしているようで、その間にアメが明らかに盗んだピィの人形を隠している。

key: ELIAS: ...
en: ELIAS: ...
ja: イライアス: ……

key: ELIAS: Amethyst, this is \PN. They are--
en: ELIAS: Amethyst, this is \PN. They are--
ja: イライアス: アメジスト、こちらは\PNです。この方は――

key: AME: From the future, right?
en: AME: From the future, right?
ja: アメ: 未来から来たんだよね?

key: ELIAS: How did you--
en: ELIAS: How did you--
ja: イライアス: どうしてそれを――

key: AME: Oh, please, one doesn't get to be the head of a League without learning a few things here and there.
en: AME: Oh, please, one doesn't get to be the head of a League without learning a few things here and there.
ja: アメ: あら、リーグのトップになるには、あちこちで色々学んでおかないとね。

key: It can time travel, right?
en: It can time travel, right?
ja: 時間旅行できるんでしょ?

key: Although honestly, what I noticed first was you.
en: Although honestly, what I noticed first was you.
ja: 正直、最初に気づいたのはあんたの方だったけどね。

key: You seem a bit... softer.
en: You seem a bit... softer.
ja: なんかちょっと……柔らかくなった感じ?

key: ELIAS: If you say so.
en: ELIAS: If you say so.
ja: イライアス: そう言うのであれば、そうなのでしょう。

key: Ahem, well, yes. We're from... I'm not sure exactly how far, but definitely the future.
en: Ahem, well, yes. We're from... I'm not sure exactly how far, but definitely the future.
ja: ゴホン、まあ、その通りです。私たちは……正確にどれくらい先かはわかりませんが、確かに未来から来ました。

key: AME: Well however long it is, I'm glad you seem to be a bit less high-strung.
en: AME: Well however long it is, I'm glad you seem to be a bit less high-strung.
ja: アメ: まあ、どれくらい先だとしても、あんたが前より肩の力抜けてるみたいで良かったよ。

key: Anyway though!
en: Anyway though!
ja: それはさておき!

key: Who is this \PN person, and why are you both in the past?
en: Who is this \PN person, and why are you both in the past?
ja: この\PNって人は誰なの、それになんで二人とも過去にいるわけ?

key: ELIAS: Ah, he is...
en: ELIAS: Ah, he is...
ja: イライアス: ああ、彼は……

key: ELIAS: Ah, she is...
en: ELIAS: Ah, she is...
ja: イライアス: ああ、彼女は……

key: ELIAS: Ah, they are...
en: ELIAS: Ah, they are...
ja: イライアス: ああ、彼らは……

key: The next Champion of Reborn.
en: The next Champion of Reborn.
ja: リボーンの次のチャンピオンです。

key: You did your job well.
en: You did your job well.
ja: よくやってくれましたね。

key: AME: Thanks El, that's very sweet of you...
en: AME: Thanks El, that's very sweet of you...
ja: アメ: ありがとエル、優しいこと言ってくれるじゃん……

key: Wait.
en: Wait.
ja: 待って。

key: Did you just say Champion?
en: Did you just say Champion?
ja: 今、チャンピオンって言った?

key: So... the League really works?
en: So... the League really works?
ja: つまり……リーグって本当に機能してるの?

key: Inviting trainers from all around the world, and one manages to win...
en: Inviting trainers from all around the world, and one manages to win...
ja: 世界中からトレーナーを招待して、その中の一人が勝つなんて……

key: And one so brilliantly talented, too!
en: And one so brilliantly talented, too!
ja: しかもこんなに素晴らしい才能のある子が!

key: ELIAS: Yes, I couldn't describe the League as anything but a success if it attracted such an effective Champion.
en: ELIAS: Yes, I couldn't describe the League as anything but a success if it attracted such an effective Champion.
ja: イライアス: ええ、これほど有能なチャンピオンを引きつけたのなら、このリーグは成功以外の何ものでもなかったと言えますね。

key: AME: Well, that's a huge relief, given that I've never once known what I'm doing here.
en: AME: Well, that's a huge relief, given that I've never once known what I'm doing here.
ja: アメ: それはすごく安心する話だよ、あたし自分がここで何やってるかなんて一度もわかってなかったんだから。

key: Even just acting as the Champion myself was only meant to be temporary until we finally did have a winner.
en: Even just acting as the Champion myself was only meant to be temporary until we finally did have a winner.
ja: あたし自身がチャンピオンをやってたのだって、ちゃんとした勝者が出るまでの一時的なものにすぎなかったの。

key: But I shouldn't have been so worried.
en: But I shouldn't have been so worried.
ja: でも、あんなに心配する必要なかったんだよね。

key: After all, I had all of your help!
en: After all, I had all of your help!
ja: だって、あんたたちみんなの助けがあったんだから!

key: A member of the Elite Four from the old League also taking that role in this newer one...
en: A member of the Elite Four from the old League also taking that role in this newer one...
ja: 昔のリーグの四天王の一人が、この新しいリーグでも同じ役目を担ってくれるなんて……

key: I don't think I could have done it without you, Elias.
en: I don't think I could have done it without you, Elias.
ja: イライアス、あんたがいなかったら、あたしにはできなかったと思う。

key: Your willingness to help me organize this League and figure out how to run this...
en: Your willingness to help me organize this League and figure out how to run this...
ja: このリーグを組織して、どうやって運営するか考えるのを手伝ってくれたこと……

key: Whatever great success this League has in your time, you should know that you are just as, if not more responsible than I am.
en: Whatever great success this League has in your time, you should know that you are just as, if not more responsible than I am.
ja: あんたの時代にこのリーグがどんな大きな成功を収めているとしても、あんたはあたしと同じくらい、それ以上に責任があるってこと、忘れないでね。

key: Thank you, Elias.
en: Thank you, Elias.
ja: ありがとう、イライアス。

key: ELIAS: I...
en: ELIAS: I...
ja: イライアス: 私は……

key: Responsible for what happens with the League, you say?
en: Responsible for what happens with the League, you say?
ja: リーグに何が起きようと、その責任があると、そうおっしゃるのですか?

key: I think you're right...
en: I think you're right...
ja: あなたの言う通りかもしれません……

key: AME: But here I go, talking your ear off!
en: AME: But here I go, talking your ear off!
ja: アメ: って、あたしまたしゃべりすぎちゃったね!

key: I'm sure you both have very important business to attend to back home.
en: I'm sure you both have very important business to attend to back home.
ja: 二人とも、自分の時代に戻ってやらなきゃいけない大事な用事があるはずだよね。

key: Shimmer and I have very important official legal League business that requires us to stay in this room, too.
en: Shimmer and I have very important official legal League business that requires us to stay in this room, too.
ja: シマーとあたしも、この部屋にいなきゃいけない、超重要な公式リーグ業務があるからさ。

key: So don't let me keep you!
en: So don't let me keep you!
ja: だから、あたしにあんたたちを引き止めさせないでよ!

key: Be sure to say "Hi" to me back in your time!
en: Be sure to say "Hi" to me back in your time!
ja: 自分の時代に戻ったら、あたしによろしくって言うの忘れないでね!

key: ???: Come on... Just a little closer...
en: ???: Come on... Just a little closer...
ja: ???: おいで……もう少しだけ近くに……

key: TAKA: Wait, that sounds like...
en: TAKA: Wait, that sounds like...
ja: タカ: 待って、これって……

key: Uh, I don't think we're quite in the present yet, \PN.
en: Uh, I don't think we're quite in the present yet, \PN.
ja: えっと、まだ現在には戻れてないみたいだね、\PN。

key: ELIAS: That... is not Anna's voice.
en: ELIAS: That... is not Anna's voice.
ja: イライアス: それは……アンナの声ではありませんね。

key: ...I see.
en: ...I see.
ja: ……なるほど。

key: Shimmer is politely watching you, but you can tell she's eager to get back to the rescue mission.
en: Shimmer is politely watching you, but you can tell she's eager to get back to the rescue mission.
ja: シマーは礼儀正しくあなたを見つめているが、早く救出ミッションに戻りたがっているのがわかる。

key: TAKA: Agent Borealis...
en: TAKA: Agent Borealis...
ja: タカ: ボレアリス捜査官……

key: That's what we called Corey.
en: That's what we called Corey.
ja: 俺たち、コーリーのことをそう呼んでたんだ。

key: Elena seemed so sure he'd do great things.
en: Elena seemed so sure he'd do great things.
ja: エレナは彼がすごいことを成し遂げるって、すごく確信してた様子だった。

key: She made him sound so happy. Full of life.
en: She made him sound so happy. Full of life.
ja: エレナの話し方だと、彼はすごく幸せそうで。生き生きしてた。

key: The Borealis I knew was so... empty.
en: The Borealis I knew was so... empty.
ja: 俺の知ってるボレアリスは、なんかすごく……空っぽだった。

key: I guess after he lost her...
en: I guess after he lost her...
ja: 多分、彼女を失った後は……

key: TAKA: I guess this is another Elite Four room?
en: TAKA: I guess this is another Elite Four room?
ja: タカ: これもまた四天王の部屋なのかな?

key: This one is kind of creepy.
en: This one is kind of creepy.
ja: なんかこの部屋、ちょっと不気味だな。

key: ELIAS: Ah, we're still in the past.
en: ELIAS: Ah, we're still in the past.
ja: イライアス: ああ、まだ過去にいるようですね。

key: Because this room belongs to...
en: Because this room belongs to...
ja: この部屋の持ち主は……

key: Huh.
en: Huh.
ja: おや。

key: I had completely forgotten about Anna until we got here.
en: I had completely forgotten about Anna until we got here.
ja: ここに来るまで、アンナのことをすっかり忘れておりました。

key: In our time, she is unavailable, so her chamber has already been decommissioned.
en: In our time, she is unavailable, so her chamber has already been decommissioned.
ja: 私たちの時代では、彼女は現役ではないため、この部屋はすでに廃止されております。

key: In our time, Anna is unavailable, so her chamber has already been decommissioned.
en: In our time, Anna is unavailable, so her chamber has already been decommissioned.
ja: 私たちの時代では、アンナは現役ではないため、この部屋はすでに廃止されております。

key: So this is clearly the recent past, but still the past nonetheless.
en: So this is clearly the recent past, but still the past nonetheless.
ja: つまり、これは明らかに最近の過去ではありますが、それでも過去には違いありません。

key: ELIAS: You know, I always found this room rather unsettling.
en: ELIAS: You know, I always found this room rather unsettling.
ja: イライアス: そういえば、私はいつもこの部屋を少し落ち着かないものだと感じておりました。

key: Although she is a rather unsettling child, so perhaps that is fitting.
en: Although she is a rather unsettling child, so perhaps that is fitting.
ja: もっとも、彼女自身も少々落ち着かない子ですから、それが似合っているのかもしれません。

key: Despite that, I suppose she has her own sort of wisdom.
en: Despite that, I suppose she has her own sort of wisdom.
ja: とはいえ、彼女には彼女なりの知恵があるのだと思います。

key: Not to mention a Legendary Pokémon of her own.
en: Not to mention a Legendary Pokémon of her own.
ja: それに、彼女自身の伝説のポケモンもいますし。

key: Perhaps this is exactly what Celebi needs.
en: Perhaps this is exactly what Celebi needs.
ja: おそらく、これはセレビィにとってまさに必要なことなのでしょう。

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
